column1: # Same TP=2 plumbing test, on h100-47. h100-96 (the memory-correct 70B line) was
# 100 percent allocated cluster-wide (every one of its 11 nodes at 2/2 GPUs), so job
# 825253 could not start. h100-47 has 4 fully idle nodes and a per-user cap of 4.
# The device assertion runs BEFORE the download, so if h100-47 turns out to be MIG
# slices like a100-40, this refuses in seconds at zero download cost.
